blocks.text: GENEVA, Switzerland—Some 5.8 million refugee children were out of school in 2025, the United Nations said Friday, warning that funding cuts threatened to make the situation worse. UNHCR, the UN refugee agency, said 44 percent of the world’s 13.1 million school-age refugee children were out of school last year. “Education is protection. But it is also a pathway to opportunity and self-reliance,” said Barham Salih, the UN high commissioner for refugees. “At a time of severe pressure on humanitarian and development financing, cuts to education risk reversing decades of collective investment and closing opportunities for a generation of young people.” The former […]...
